observation.command: cd /workspace; git log --all --oneline -S "geocoder:geocoder" -- profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/ | head; echo "=== grep all branches info ==="; for b in $(git branch -a --format='%(refname)' | grep -v HEAD); do echo "-- $b"; git show $b:profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml 2>/dev/null | grep -n "dependencies" -A5; done 2>&1 | head -60
